description: A map of tuples whose objects lack an optional object attribute in one element fails to convert
notes: The README says missing optional attributes become null, so each element converts to a tuple of an object whose attribute a is an object with a string attribute x, null for k2, and the map should convert. hashicorp/hcl fails: go-cty's conversionMapToObject (cty/convert/conversion_collection.go) gives the missing attribute a null whose type still marks x as optional, unlike k1's converted attribute, and conversionCollectionToMap unifies the converted elements only when the map's element type is a collection or object type, not a tuple type, so the two elements keep different types and the map can't be made. With objects instead of tuples the conversion works (native/type-expressions/defaults-map-elements-missing-optional-object-unified). The test uses convert-with-defaults, which converts once as applications do, because hashicorp/hcl's convert fails for any missing optional attribute (native/type-expressions/convert-missing-optional-attribute).
reference_error: element types must all match for conversion to map
